purpose: Teach: 桂/柏/藍/圭/乃/嘉/肇/ヨウ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが桂離宮の写真を撮りに行かれた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he went to photograph Katsura Imperial Villa.
lines.style: Soft, reaching-back tone. Gentle pause before the villa name, as if placing it carefully in time. Slow, measured. The voice of someone holding a memory lightly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、毎年五月に柏餅を作って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—Grandpa used to make kashiwa mochi for us every May, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, present-tense affection in her voice. A small, certain smile underneath. She's checking in with him gently, inviting him to remember with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが私に藍染めの着物を仕立てて下さった
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he had an indigo kimono specially made for me.
lines.style: Quieter this time. The memory lands differently—something made for him. Slight catch, like touching something woven with intention. Slower pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の圭くんを膝にお乗せだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you used to set our grandson Kei right on your lap, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful, a touch of gentle teasing. She's watching him remember. Warmth with a small glint—she knows he loved that. Light, intimate cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが詩で「美乃君の名」って詠まれた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he wrote a poem with the words "Mino's name" in it.
lines.style: Even quieter. The poetry matters—there's reverence here. Breath held slightly around the poem itself. Searching tone, like asking if she remembers this too.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、嘉永年間の古文書を蒐集されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you collected old documents from the Kaei period, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Admiring, steady. She's establishing his world—what mattered to him. Certain and warm. A brief pause before "dear," as if offering it as a gift of recognition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「会社の肇は信用」と教えられた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he taught me that the foundation of any company is trust.
lines.style: This lands differently—a lesson carried forward. Deliberate. Quiet conviction underneath. The words matter because they've shaped him. Slightly firmer than before.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ヨウ素入り消毒薬を常備されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, you always kept iodine disinfectant on hand, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle amusement—practical love, the kind that prepares. She's reciting his small, careful habits with affection. Warm close, voice fading slightly on "dear."
